messages:
Alex Chen: Starting eu-south1 GPU cluster bootstrap now. Posting concise checklist and owners: registry=Maria, gitops/helm=Jyoti, autoscale/cost=Samir. Targeting A100 first. @platform-oncall :flag_eu: 

Maria Lopez: ack. I'll validate registry replication and prewarm largest model images.

Jyoti Rao: noted. I added an eu-south overlay in gitops at gitops/clusters/eu-south/values.yaml. Will dry-run Argo after registry is ready.

Samir Patel: FYI GPU SKU priorities: A100-80GB > A100-40GB > V100. Start on on-demand then switch spots for non-prod. Rough cost 18k EUR/mo for 3x A100 24/7.

deploy-bot: ArgoCD: sync app/cluster-eu-south started (commit 8f3a2d). Waiting for image pulls.

Alex Chen: Immediate checklist I'm executing:
- registry replication status (Maria)
- VPC & NAT egress
- IAM/KMS for registry pulls
- Argo/Helm sync + CRDs
- GPU driver daemonset + device plugin
- nodepools, taints/tolerations
- autoscaler + spot policy
- smoke tests for /health and a simple inference job

Maria Lopez: registry sync lagging (~8m) due to S3 replication filter. Pushing manifest digests for bert-13b and redwood-runtime to nudge replication.

Alex Chen: paste validation commands once replication finishes.

Maria Lopez: Commands to validate:
```
crane digest registry.redwood-internal/models/bert-13b:latest
crane digest registry.redwood-internal/runtime/redwood:prod-2026-03-18
kubectl -n infra logs job/registry-sync-eu-south
kubectl -n kube-system get pods | grep registry
```
Also check registry egress IPs in NAT.

Jyoti Rao: Helm notes:
- nodePools.gpu.taints => ["nvidia.com/gpu=true:NoSchedule"]
- workloads need tolerations
- pin image.digest in gitops to avoid tag races
- set imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent
- enable syncPolicy.automated.prune=true after initial validation

Samir Patel: Spot provisioning flapped during earlier attempt; scale up slowly (one spot A100 at a time). Set maxSurge:1 for nodepool rolling updates.

Alex Chen: Found a 502 on /health hitting model backend on new nodes. Root cause: private nodes lacked NAT egress for signed URL image pulls. Maria, can you update NAT firewall to allow registry egress IPs?

Maria Lopez: Updating NAT allowlist for registry.egress (adding 35.**.* range). Also extended signed URL TTL to 1h for bootstrap.

deploy-bot: registry-sync-eu-south job finished (6m42s). 3 images replicated.

Alex Chen: After fix, Helm deployed nvidia drivers and nodes joined. Commands ran:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n gpu-system
kubectl describe daemonset nvidia-driver -n gpu-system
kubectl get csr | grep Pending
```
Approved one pending CSR for node bootstrap.

Jyoti Rao: Post-deploy validation to run:
- kubectl top nodes (GPU metrics)
- run test pod using registry.redwood-internal/runtime/smoke:<digest> with limits nvidia.com/gpu=1
- check model-backend and proxy rollouts

Samir Patel: Add billing guardrails: alert when GPU spend >=80% of baseline. Auto-disable non-prod spot pools after validation window.

Alex Chen: Smoke tests good except intermittent ImagePullBackOff on one node (replication race). Mitigation: pin digests and add a pre-sync prewarm job that checks `crane digest` before Argo sync.

Maria Lopez: Added prewarm script at ci/registry/prewarm.sh with 5 retries + backoff. Pipeline now references it.

Alex Chen: Final handoff items:
- Jyoti: enable Argo automation for cluster-eu-south at 11:10 UTC
- Maria: ensure registry prewarm cron for 24h
- Samir: enable spot policy but cap initial GPU autoscale to 2
- I'll publish runbook to runbooks/eu-south-bootstrap.md and start handoff meeting at 11:30 UTC (https://meet.redwood.local/eu-south-handoff)

Jyoti Rao: I'll flip automation after one last smoke at 11:08 UTC.

Samir Patel: Setting spot cap and billing alert now.

Alex Chen: Handoff to @platform-oncall scheduled 11:30 UTC. Posting runbook and monitoring checklist in infra channel. :white_check_mark: 

Platform Oncall (Samir Patel): ack, taking post-handoff monitoring. Will escalate on ASG flapping.
